LESSON: CI green on a PR proposing a new shared-store shape is necessary but not sufficient evidence it is safe to merge when another card claims to define the same store -- read the actual competing contract before trusting either side's CI.

A migration already applied live cannot be safely edited in place (schema_migrations tracks by filename) -- a correction is always a new migration, never a retroactive file edit, even when the mistake is caught within the hour.

An external `gcloud run jobs executions cancel` bypasses in-process termination-recording entirely; a live kill test needs an explicit reap-terminate follow-up and does not self-heal the way a unit test's mocked in-process kill does.

The Factory's existing `factory-conformant reap terminate --run=<uuid> --exit-kind=<kind> --reason=<evidence> --apply` path is the sanctioned, already-built mechanism for exactly this correction -- use it over any temptation toward a laptop hand-write, and its own header comment documents the precedent this card is not the first to hit.
